title: 9V Battery
intro: The is an item used to power electrical devices in DayZ. The battery can be attached and detached. When in use its charge will gradually decrease until it becomes useless. The physical condition of the battery does not affect its charge*. The battery can be attached to powered items by clicking and dragging it over the items. To detach the battery, click and drag it back into your inventory or int

title: Alarm Clock

fields.description: Common table alarm clock. Spring powered and apparently still working.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. It's use is to tell the time as well as being able to set a time to sound an alarm. This can be used as a distraction or as a reminder.

title: Alkaline Battery

fields.name: {PAGENAME}
fields.description: Cylindrical with electrical contacts on each end, this battery is typically used in electronics that require extended run time. A bump distinguishes the positive end.

intro: The Alkaline Battery was a piece of equipment in DayZ. It was replaced by the 9V Battery early in Alpha patches.

title: Ammo Box

fields.description: A metal storage box. Originally designed for holding ammunition, but can store other things too.

intro: The Ammo Box is used as a storage item much like the First Aid Kit and the Protective Case.

title: Barbed Wire

fields.description: A roll of barbed wire. Can be used for various trap crafting, you can even use it to tie somebody down. Not that you'd want to!

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. Barbed Wire can be added to the outer upper and lower parts of a Fence using a Pliers and causes serious damage to players when contact is made with it. Barbed Wire can also be used to tie up Survivors and can cause the player to begin Bleeding when they attempt to break free of their restraints.

title: Battery Charger

fields.description: Used to charge truck or car batteries when plugged into running electric grid.

intro: The is a vehicle repair component in DayZ.

title: Bear Trap

fields.description: Old-fashioned but functional, this marvel of mechanical engineering can almost snap your leg in half.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. This item can be found in Hunting Stands and single-room cabins within summer camps. When triggered it will break the survivor's legs as well as doing 27.5 health damage, and 20 shock damage. While also doing 90 damage to the players pants, ruining weaker pants like Hiking Pants and Tracksuit Pants and leaving almost all others in a Damaged/Badly Damaged state.

title: Binoculars

fields.description: Handheld binoculars. Although not as stable or powerful as tripod-mounted telescope, it can still serve as a powerful surveillance tool.

intro: are a hand-held device that can be used to view objects at a distance. They are useful for scouting an environment from afar for survivor or infected activity.

title: Birch Broom

fields.name: Birch Broom
fields.description: Handmade sweeping untensil. The design is old, but still effective to scare children.

intro: The is a type of weapon in DayZ. It was implemented in the DayZ 1.12 update for the Walpurgis Event that spanned between April 29, 2021, and May 16, 2021.

title: Blowtorch

fields.description: Metalworking tool; primarily used to cut and weld metal. It's designed to be fed by gas canisters.

intro: A is a piece of equipment in DayZ. It can be used to repair metal objects, such as vehicles, barrels, cookware and base infrastructure. It can also be used to start fires in a Fireplace or Fire Barrel.

title: Bone Fishing Hook

fields.variant: [Bone Fishing Hook|Without Bait], [Bone Fishing Bait|With Bait]
fields.description: A piece of carved bone which can be used as an improvised fishing hook.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ used to catch fish. They can be stored as an attachment on Boonie Hats. The has a 0.5 % chance to be lost whilst fishing. It is worse than the Fishing Hook at catching fish.

title: Bone Knife

fields.name: Bone Knife
fields.description: Once sharpened, this bone has revealed itself to be a decent knife.

intro: The is a player-crafted tool that can also be used as a bladed weapon in DayZ.

title: Broom

fields.name: Broom
fields.description: A cleaning tool consisting of stiff fibbers attached to, and roughly parallel to, a cylindrical handle, the broomstick. Mostly used to clean floors, also useful for getting rid of spider webs and scaring away animals.

intro: The is a type of weapon in DayZ. It can also be used as a Torch for a source of light, or broken into sticks. The Damage increses if the broom has been lit. The second damage value in the infobox is the damage if lit.

title: Burlap Sack

fields.description: Burlap sack is ideal for shipping and storing seeds, potatoes etc. It has a drawstring closure at the top of the bag.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. It is used to craft the Burlap Courier Bag, Burlap Backpack and Burlap Strips.

title: Can Opener

fields.description: This common household instrument is used to smoothly open metal/tin cans, with no content spilling.

intro: The is an item which can be used to open canned goods such as Canned Baked Beans in DayZ.

title: Canopy Tent

fields.description: A canopy, often seen at farmers' markets. With some camouflage, it makes for a decent hideout.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. Added in patch 1.08.

title: Canteen

fields.description: A reusable plastic bottle used by military and campers. Can be filled with various liquids.

intro: The is a portable source of drinking water that survivors can use to replenish their thirst.

title: Car Battery

fields.description: 12V rechargable car battery, usable in cars. It can be used to power other appliances, if connected properly.

intro: The is a crucial vehicle component in DayZ. Without a battery, you cannot start the engine.

title: Car Tent

fields.description: A large tent, spacious enough to shelter a parked vehicle or a pile of equipment.

intro: The is a highly sought after tent in DayZ. Boasting the largest amount of storage space of all the Storage & Tents, the is even capable of housing a vehicle inside of it.

title: Combat Knife

fields.description: Sharp combat knife with a sturdy blade and a handle. Great for self-defense, but it has other, more mundane uses as well.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon in DayZ.

title: Combination Lock

fields.description: A multi-dial combination lock with a chain long enough for wooden logs of constructed gates.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. It can be attached to Fence gates to lock the door.

title: Compass

fields.description: A classic compass. Helps with orientation, provided you know how to use it properly.

intro: The Compass is a navigational aid used to tell the cardinal direction of the operator.

fields.description: Container key with a round bit made out of metal.

title: Crowbar

fields.description: Standard curved crowbar. Read instructions before use. May cause injuries if handled improperly.

intro: The is a tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ.

title: Crude Machete

fields.name: Crude Machete
fields.description: A quite solid machete with a sharp blade. Although it looks like scrap metal it's a very efficient cutting tool.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.13 Experimental patch on 17th June 2021.

title: Drysack

fields.description: Flexible watertight container. Capable of protecting contents from dust, sand, dirt and water.

intro: The is a small storage container in DayZ. Like a Wooden Crate these bags can be buried using a shovel or pickaxe to store loot.

title: Equipment/hu
intro: Felszerelésnek számít minden olyan objektum, ami viselhető és (vagy) bizonyos célokat szolgál. A játékos számára a környezet interakciójának széles skáláját teszik elérhetővé (a crafting rendszerrel egyetemben).

title: Fange

fields.name: Fange
fields.description: Handcrafted knife. It seems to be an heirloom of some hunter.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.12 Experimental patch on 1st April 2021.

title: Farming Hoe

fields.name: Farming Hoe
fields.description: A farming hoe also known as the Dutch hoe with a sharp piece of metal at the end of a wooden rod pointing in sharp angle designed to cultivate soil or penetrate any fragile or soft object.

intro: The is an agriculture tool that can be used to dig up earthworms for fishing bait or it can be used as a weapon. However, its primary use is in horticulture as it provides a means to dig plots for planting seeds. This is particularly useful for players who wish to avoid towns while still being able to have enough food to survive in Chernarus.

title: Festive Lights

fields.description: A string with colorful electric lights. Can be hung around for the special festive look.

intro: are a type of equipment in DayZ.

fields.name: Field Shovel
fields.description: An entrenching tool is a collapsible spade used by military forces for a variety of military purposes. Survivalists, freedivers, campers, hikers and other outdoors groups have found it to be indispensable in field use.

title: Field Transceiver

fields.description: An R-105 portable base radio station.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. The can send and receive signals server wide.

title: Filtering Bottle

fields.description: This useful survival tool serves both as a container for storing water and as a means to purify it. When used for drinking it removes almost any common waterborne disease found in the wilderness.

intro: The serves as a specialized water container that removes all Heavy Metal Poisoning and Cholera pathogens in the water when a survivor drinks from it. Unlike Chlorine Tablets, the does not clear the water of Common Cold/Influenza, Salmonella or PO-X Poison.

title: Firefighter Axe

fields.description: Firefighter axe is used primarily for breaking down doors and windows. Can be also used for wood cutting or other mundane activities.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon and multipurpose tool in DayZ.

title: Fireworks Launcher

fields.description: Box full of fireworks, ready to light any party up. It's probably still good, even if mildly damaged or damp. Do not ignite while indoors and stay away from it after ignition.

intro: The is a placeable object that may be ignited with a Petrol Lighter and once activated will fire a rocket every 5 seconds for 1 minute. The can not be placed under any objects or roofs. If you are within 2 meters of a while it is active you will take 2 Health damage every time it fires. The item is most useful for distracting zombies as they are drawn to it.

title: First Aid Pouch

fields.description: A textile pouch used to carry and protect first aid kit, mainly from the weather exposure.

intro: The is a small item container used primarily for the storage of medical supplies in a similar nature to that of the ammo box.

title: Fishing Hook

fields.description: Steel fishing hook, durable and reliable, just add the bait.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. It is used in conjunction with earthworms to create fishing bait, which is then used to go fishing.

fields.description: Power hungry household appliance to prevent your ketchup and sad vegetables from ageing.

title: GPS Receiver

fields.description: A sophisticated device that can receive a signal from the global positioning system, triangulate user's position, and calculate their altitude. Requires a battery to operate.

intro: The is a navigation and information device in DayZ, it is used to display the players world position and altitude. It can also 'combine' with the Tourist Map, displaying its information inside an open map screen.

title: Garrafa de Plástico/pt-br

fields.description: Uma garrafa reutilizável. Embora inicialmente contivesse água de nascente, pode conter vários líquidos.
fields.name: Garrafa de Plástico

intro: A é um recurso portátil para se tomar água, assim os sobreviventes podem matar sua sede.

title: Gas Canister

fields.variant: [Small Gas Canister|Small], [Medium Gas Canister|Medium], [Large Gas Canister|Large]
fields.description: Contains butane which is provided to gas-powered camping equipment after attaching it.

intro: A is a canister that holds butane gas for use in gas devices.

title: Gas Mask Filter

fields.location: [Krasnostav Airfield] (yellow medical tents); On the bodies of NBC [Infected] inside a [Contaminated Zone]
fields.description: A respirator cartridge. Designed to fit the most common gas masks mounts.

intro: The is an attachable filter for the Gas Mask and NBC Respirator in DayZ. A filter must be attached to a gas mask to enter a contaminated zone without contracting the contamination illness, alongside wearing a full NBC suit.

title: Glass Bottle

fields.description: Reusable bottle made out of glass that can contain any type of liquid.

intro: The is a liquid container in DayZ.

title: Hacksaw

fields.name: Hacksaw
fields.description: Invaluable crafting tool, intended to saw off metal pipes. It has other uses as well.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ.

title: Hammer

fields.description: A multi-purpose tool. Mostly thanks to the fact, that, after a while, everything tends to look like a nail.

intro: The is a tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ.

title: Hand Drill Kit

fields.description: A hand drill kit. Can be used for starting a fire.

intro: The is a tool that can be crafted and used to start fires. You need a knife or other suitable tool to gather bark. To create a hand drill kit, simply combine bark and a wooden stick. When using a hand drill kit, be advised that there is a chance it will fail to light the fire; this will consume the hand drill kit and you will need to make another.

title: Hand Saw

fields.name: Hand Saw
fields.description: A handy carpenter tool designed to saw through wood. Useful for construction or woodworking.

intro: The is a type of tool in DayZ.

title: Handcuff Keys

fields.description: Small metal keys for opening handcuffs. Losing them makes opening handcuffs a hassle.

intro: are a type of equipment in DayZ. They are used specifically to unlock Handcuffs. Other than unlocking the Handcuffs, there is no other use for them as of update 1.13.

title: Handcuffs

fields.description: Steel handcuffs, useful for handcuffing your friends and foes. As they can be locked easily, having keys to unlock them is recommended.

intro: are a type of equipment in DayZ.

title: Handheld Transceiver

fields.description: Medium range, two-way personal radio with a frequency switch. Requires a battery to operate.

intro: The is a communication device in DayZ, when used in conjunction with a second , both set to the same frequency, survivors can communicate with each other over a 5 kilometer range in-game. They can be found in various locations and require a Alkaline Battery 9V to function.

title: Hatchet

fields.description: Single-handed bladed tool with a hammer head on one side. Except for chopping wood, it has a wide array of uses.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon and multipurpose tool in DayZ.

title: Hunting Knife

fields.description: This hunting knife is used during hunting to skin animals and cut up the meat.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon and multipurpose tool in DayZ. The Hunting Knife, along with the Combat Knife and the Steak Knife, has the distinctive ability to be stored inside of Military Boots, saving inventory space or, if used as the primary melee weapon, making the player's profile smaller. This ability, combined with its solid damage output and multiple uses as a tool, make the Hunting Knife

title: Improvised Gas Mask Filter

fields.description: Not the most reliable of designs, but definitely effective when in need.

intro: The is an attachable filter for the Gas Mask and NBC Respirator in DayZ. A filter must be attached to a gas mask to enter a contaminated zone without contracting the contamination illness, alongside wearing a full NBC suit.

title: Jerrycan

fields.description: A metal canister, useful for storing large volumes of gasoline or other liquids.

intro: The is a piece of equipment that is used to fuel vehicles using fuel obtained at a Gas Station. The canister can also be emptied and filled with water, to be used as a large supply of that resource away from typical water sources.

fields.name: {PAGENAME}
fields.description: A bayonet for KA based assault rifles with a bayonet lug.

title: Kitchen Knife

fields.description: A sharp kitchen knife with broad blade and a sturdy handle. Can handle vegetable as well as meat.

intro: The is a multipurpose tool that can also be used as a bladed weapon in DayZ.

fields.description: Turn it or burn it.

title: Kukri

fields.name: Kukri
fields.description: An exotic heavy blade. Effective on wood as on flesh.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.12 Experimental patch on 1st April 2021.

title: Large Gas Canister

fields.variant: [Small Gas Canister|Small], [Medium Gas Canister|Medium], [Large Gas Canister|Large]
fields.description: Contains butane which is provided to gas-powered camping equipment after attaching it.

intro: A is a canister used to store butane gas for use in a gas devices.

title: Large Gift Box

fields.description: A gift box. Usually used to wrap presents, but they have been known to contain loot.

intro: The was added as part of the 0.62.143640 update which included new items for the Christmas holiday. This box is the largest of all the gift containers, each of which spawns containing randomized loot.

title: Large Tent

fields.description: A large military tent. It can house a small unit, along with its equipment.

intro: For the military buildings, see Military Tents.

fields.description: A pouch sewn from tanned leather. Made watertight to allow for carrying of various liquids.

title: Lock Pick

fields.description: Universal lockpick. A set of different lock picking tools in one package specifically manufactured for the purpose of picking different types of locks. It's pretty sturdy, yet has a compact build, very handy in many situations.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. It is used to lock and unlock doors for the purpose of securing a building against other players. It can also be used to unlock locked doors from other players, giving your team an advantage in battle. You can also lock sheds that you stashed your loot in, in between server restarts. Therefor making this a very powerful item in PVP, when used correctly. Anyone c

fields.name: {PAGENAME}
fields.description: A bayonet for M4-A1 assault rifle with a bayonet lug.
Surprisingly sharp large machete. It is basically a big knife. Very useful for self-defense.

title: Matches

fields.description: A box of long kitchen safety matches. Store in dry place and keep away from children.

intro: The , or Matchbox, is a type of equipment in DayZ. They can be used to light fires, or torches. Matches cannot be used to start a fire when exposed to rain. As of 1.12 can be combined with other boxes of matches, but a single box can not be split.

title: Medium Gas Canister

fields.variant: [Small Gas Canister|Small], [Medium Gas Canister|Medium], [Large Gas Canister|Large]
fields.description: Contains butane which is provided to gas-powered camping equipment after attaching it.

intro: A is a canister that holds butane gas for use in gas devices.

title: Medium Gift Box

fields.description: A gift box. Usually used to wrap presents, but they have been known to contain loot.

intro: The was added as part of the 0.62.143640 update which included new items for the Christmas holiday. This box is the middle of three sizes for the gift containers, each of which spawns containing randomized loot.

title: Medium Tent

fields.description: A camping tent. Offers a comfortable and dry space, with additional storage space.

intro: The is a personal camping tent in DayZ. When deployed it can be used to store items beyond the capacity of what the player is able to carry.

title: Megaphone

fields.description: A megaphone.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. Increases audible range of voice chat to at least 215 meters.

title: Metal Wire

fields.description: Multi-purpose thin metal wire useful in many situations.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. It is used in Crafting alongside other items to create tools for the player, such as a gate.

fields.name: {PAGENAME}
fields.description: A bayonet for Mosin 91/30 rifle with a bayonet lug.

title: Nails

fields.description: A stack of 8.89cm long nails.

intro: The are a type of equipment in DayZ. Boxes contain a fixed amount of 70 nails, however, the unpacked nails can be stacked up to 99. They can be combined with a Baseball Bat to make it a more potent weapon or combined with Planks to create a Wooden Crate. Nails can also be placed in an Oil Barrel to dye leather items black.

title: Netting

fields.description: Netting with small spaces between yarn. Used to make fishnet or make a base for camoflague

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. It is used exclusively in Crafting (see below).

title: Oil Barrel

fields.description: Oil barrel for storing stuff and various liquids in large volumes. Used to catch water or craft things over time.

intro: Blowtorch

title: Oriental Machete

fields.name: Oriental Machete
fields.description: An exotic heavy blade. Effective on wood as on flesh.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon in DayZ. It was first introduced in the 1.13 Experimental patch on 17th June 2021.

title: Orienteering Compass

fields.description: Used for hiking, its needle points to the north, helping with orientation. It is very hard to get lost with one of these.

intro: The , like the regular compass, is a navigational aid used to tell the cardinal direction of the operator.

title: Paper

fields.description: Sheet of paper, can be used as kindling or for writing, among other things.

intro: is a piece of equipment in DayZ. is used to make Fireplaces.

title: Petrol Lighter

fields.description: A simple plastic lighter, filled with pressurized gas. Unsurprisingly, it can be used to light stuff on fire.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ. It can be used to light fires even when it's wet, unlike matches. Uses 3% of it's fuel every use

title: Pickaxe

fields.description: As a digging tool, a pickaxe can indeed be used to dig, mine, or even defend oneself if needed.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon and multipurpose tool in DayZ. Often overlooked for its large size and perceived lack of functionality, the Pickaxe deals some of the highest amount of damage in melee combat. With a range matching both the Firefighter Axe and Splitting Axe, the Pickaxe is a dangerous weapon.

title: Pipe Wrench

fields.name: Pipe Wrench
fields.description: Adjustable wrench. Once used for turning nuts or bolts, now it makes a decent blunt weapon.

intro: The is a type of melee weapon in DayZ. It can no longer be used to repair engines in vehicles as of V1.19.

title: Plastic Bottle

fields.description: A reusable bottle. Even though it originally contained spring water, it can contain various liquids.

intro: The is a portable source of drinking water that survivors can use to replenish their thirst.

title: Pliers

fields.description: Metal tool with head resembling jaws. Definitely useful for wire cutting and some light bending.

intro: The is a multi-purpose tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ. They are an essential tool to build gates from fences (after adding a metal wire), thus a very important tool for base building. Not so easily found.

title: Pouches

fields.description: Pouches attachable to plate carrier vest. Further increase its carrying capacity.

intro: The is a piece of modular clothing in DayZ. It can be combined with the Plate Carrier to add the capacity to carry items on the vest itself.

title: Power Generator

fields.description: Portable gasoline-powered generator. Provides enough electricity to power a small home for as long as the fuel lasts.

intro: The is a type of equipment in DayZ.

title: Protective Case

fields.description: A rugged, plastic, airtight container. Very durable, used to protect sensitive gear.

intro: The can be used to store 12 slots worth of items. Keeping items in it will protect them from damage otherwise incurred onto them. As such, this container comes in handy in protecting valuable/rare items -- such as ammo -- from damage during firefights. They can also be buried with a Shovel. It can be combined with an Electrical Repair Kit to create an Improvised Explosive.

title: Punched Card

fields.description: A thick sheet of paper in which some holes have been punched. Their pattern looks to be instructions or data for an input device of some kind.

intro: A is an item in DayZ Standalone that's used to unlock and access Underground Bunker in Livonia.

title: Rangefinder

fields.description: It lacks the magnification and stability of binoculars, but makes up for it by its ability to precisely measure long range distances.

intro: The is a distance-measuring optical device in DayZ. It allows the operator to measure a distance between them and the target spot, determining the distance to it within 1m accuracy. It is commonly used by snipers or sniper teams (a sniper and a spotter) for the purpose of zeroing the optics on their weapons for long range engagements.

title: Rope

fields.description: Strong rope, used to tie stuff together, be it things or people.

intro: is a type of equipment in DayZ. It can be used to craft Backpacks, a Simple Fishing Rod, or Fence Kits.

title: SK 59/66 Bayonet

fields.description: A bayonet for SK 59/66 rifle with a bayonet lug.

intro: The is a weapon attachment in DayZ.

fields.description: Resistant case made of thick metal. It has protective foam inside and is used to carrying confidential documents and fragile items.
Metal key with a colored plastic cover

title: Screwdriver

fields.description: Regular screwdriver. Can be gently inserted into a screw, or into somebody's jugular.

intro: is a tool that can also be used as a bladed weapon in DayZ. A rather bad weapon, the Screwdriver lacks both damage and range which makes it a poor choice for a primary melee weapon. Also lacking in functionality, only able to cut some restraints and open canned food, the Screwdriver is really only useful to freshly spawned players.

title: Sea Chest

fields.description: A spacious storage box. Quite heavy, but seems to be durable.

intro: The is a large storage container in DayZ. Although it does not have the storage capacity of an Oil Barrel or tents, the is able to be buried in an Underground Stash making it much harder for bandits to find and raid. The can be repaired using a wooden plank.

fields.description: Sturdy knife sheath, made from reinforced fiber mesh. Can be hung from the belt.

title: Sheet Metal

fields.description: Metal sheets, great if you need to do some serious building, otherwise not that useful.

intro: are a type of equipment in DayZ. Can be used only for base building. This item can be carried in stacks of 10.

title: Shovel

fields.description: Ordinary shovel. Strong, steel blade easily splits both soil and skulls.

intro: The is a multi-purpose tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ.

title: Sickle

fields.name: Sickle
fields.description: A hand-held agricultural tool with a curved blade. Typically used for harvesting grain crops or cutting succulent forage.

intro: The is a type of weapon in DayZ.

title: Sledgehammer

fields.description: Flat metal head can apply more force than other hammers, due to its large size. Certainly useful for various demolition purposes.

intro: The is a tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ.

title: Small Gift Box

fields.variant: [Small Gift Box|Small], [Medium Gift Box|Medium], [Large Gift Box|Large]
fields.description: A gift box. Usually used to wrap presents, but they have been known to contain loot.

intro: The is a seasonal item in DayZ. It was added as part of the 0.62.143640 update which included new items for the Christmas holiday. This box is the smallest of all the gift containers, each of which spawns containing randomized loot.

title: Splitting Axe

fields.description: Useful for splitting wood or other objects, including closed cans and an occasional forehead.

intro: The is a bladed melee weapon and multipurpose tool in DayZ. As of 1.0, the Splitting Axe has surpassed its brother, the Firefighter Axe, in terms of damage and is second only to the Pickaxe. Equal in range to both, the Splitting Axe is a deadly melee weapon. In addition to having all of the same functionality the Firefighter Axe provides, the Splitting Axe boasts more durability in its role as a t

title: Steak Knife

fields.description: A sharp table knife, used for cutting steak. Serrated blade cuts any meat with ease.

intro: The is a multipurpose tool that can also be used as a bladed weapon in DayZ. The Steak Knife, along with the Hunting Knife and the Combat Knife, has the distinctive ability to be stored inside of Assault Boots, saving inventory space or, if used as the primary melee weapon, making the player's profile smaller. While it has the same damage as the Kitchen Knife, it has a slightly shorter range.

title: Stone Knife

fields.name: Stone Knife
fields.description: A shard of stone. Not very durable or sharp, but useful, if you have nothing else at hand.

intro: The is a player-crafted tool that can also be used as a bladed weapon in DayZ. It can be crafted from a small stone sharpened against a rock or boulder (in the landscape) or sharpened using another small stone.

title: Teddy Bear

fields.description: A cute and cuddly teddy bear will make your kids happy and warm, they won't be able to resist his hugs.

intro: The is a type of container in DayZ. It is used mostly to hide small items. Teddy bears no longer contain items when spawned into the world.

title: Tire Iron

fields.description: Heavy blunt implement. Also an useful tool for getting wheels off the car for maintenance.

intro: The is a blunt weapon in DayZ. Used to lock/unlock tires to vehicles as well as separate the M3S Dual Wheel into two different tires.

title: Tourist Map

fields.description: Folded tourist map. Displays topography, marked tourist trails, useful points of interest and significant landmarks

intro: The is a navigational aid used to navigate South Zagoria and the Topolin-Nadbór Region. The Tourist Map can be used by left clicking once while having it in your hands and unequipped by pressing ESC.

fields.description: Trash can

title: Truck Battery

fields.description: 12V rechargable truck battery has higher capacity then regular car battery. It can be used to power other appliances, if connected properly.

intro: The is a vehicle component in DayZ. It is required for the M3S to function.

title: Wooden Crate

fields.description: Wooden Crate

intro: The is a crafted storage container in DayZ. Like the Sea Chest, the is able to be buried in an Underground Stash making it much harder for bandits to find and raid.

title: Wrench

fields.description: Adjustable metal wrench made for dealing with fasteners. Small enough to be used in tight space.

intro: The is a tool that can also be used as a blunt weapon in DayZ. Vehicles parts like the hood, trunk and doors can be locked with this tool.
